title: Exploring the Privacy--Size Tradeoff for Differentially Private Self-Attentive Variational Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.05582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data tends to be most useful when it is shared, and the data most worth sharing is often the data that privacy obligations restrict. Synthetic data from a generator trained under differential privacy (DP) is one way to reconcile the two, but its utility depends on the privacy budget $\varepsilon$ and on how much data the generator sees - a parameter that most data sharing applications of synthetic data control. We present SAVANT, a self-attentive variational autoencoder for tabular data trained with DP-SGD that, to our knowledge, is the first to combine attention, a VAE, and DP in one tabular model. We evaluate it against two marginal mechanisms, PrivBayes and MST, jointly over the privacy budget and the dataset size on two public datasets, measuring the utility a downstream classifier loses by training on synthetic rather than real data. translated_title: 探索差分隐私自注意力变分自编码器中的隐私与数据规模权衡
translated_abstract: 数据在共享时往往最有用，而最值得共享的数据通常正是受隐私义务限制的数据。由在差分隐私（DP）下训练的生成器产生的合成数据是调和二者矛盾的一种方式，但其效用取决于隐私预算 ε 以及生成器所接触的数据量——后者是大多数合成数据共享应用可以控制的一个参数。我们提出了 SAVANT，这是一种针对表格数据、使用 DP-SGD 训练的自注意力变分自编码器，据我们所知，这是首个在单一表格模型中同时结合注意力机制、VAE 和差分隐私的模型。我们在两个公开数据集上，联合考察隐私预算和数据集规模两个维度，将其与两种边际机制 PrivBayes 和 MST 进行对比评估，衡量下游分类器因使用合成数据而非真实数据训练所损失的效用。我们发现，在相同的差分隐私保证下，更多的数据通常意味着更高的效用。对于边际……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了SAVANT——首个在单一表格模型中结合注意力机制、变分自编码器与差分隐私的自编码器，并发现 在相同的差分隐私保证下，使用更多训练数据通常能带来更高的合成数据效用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SAVANT, the first tabular model combining attention, a VAE, and differential privacy trained with DP-SGD, and finds that under the same DP guarantee, more training data generally yields higher synthetic data utility.
